The Salon

Considered spaces, unhurried service.

Tucked into a quiet corner of Gulberg II, IRIS was built around a simple idea: a salon visit should feel like a pause, not an errand. Warm stone counters, low light and a plush lounge-style pedicure bay set the tone the moment you walk in.

From hair and colour to massage, manicure, pedicure, make-up and waxing, every chair at IRIS is arranged for comfort first — the kind of detail regulars notice and mention in almost every review.

Signature Space

The Pedicure Lounge

A wide upholstered banquette, brass fittings and warm stone — built for two friends to sit side by side, feet up, for an hour that actually feels like one. It's the space clients photograph most, and the one we're proudest of.
